listenings.text: Hi Braulio, this is Marina from the club. You asked me last week about the activities for the new season, so here they are. On Tuesdays and Thursdays we have the swimming group at seven in the morning. That one is already full, but there is a waiting list. The walking group meets on Saturdays at six thirty, and it is open to everyone. And we are starting something new in September. A discussion group that meets once a month to talk about the news, in English. Fifteen people have signed up so far. I thought of you for that one. Call me back when you can.

Good evening. Here are tonight's headlines. Ministers have agreed on a new housing bill after three weeks of negotiation, and the vote is expected on Thursday. In Washington, the president will meet European leaders on Monday to discuss trade. Closer to home, the city council has approved twelve new cycle lanes, a decision that has already divided opinion. And finally, sport. After a long season, the national team plays its last match on Sunday. The weather, after this.

extra_audio.text: Claire asks Braulio whether he is travelling for business or for pleasure. He answers that it is pleasure, and mentions the house in Bahia. Braulio explains that he retired this year, after a very demanding career. She asks whether he misses the work, and he says he misses the people but not the late nights. Claire explains that she edits a politics podcast, and Braulio offers to talk about current affairs.
